mapper.sql: c.id AS id, c.service_order_id AS serviceOrderId, c.round_no AS roundNo, c.phase AS phase, c.process_note AS processNote, c.check_result AS checkResult, c.delivery_note AS deliveryNote, c.remaining_fault AS remainingFault, c.rework_request AS reworkRequest, c.operator_name AS operatorName, c.created_at AS createdAt
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM service_completion c WHERE c.service_order_id = #{serviceOrderId} ORDER BY c.round_no ASC, CASE c.phase WHEN 'COMPLETION' THEN 0 WHEN 'REJECTED' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, c.id ASC
